name: The Rested
flavor: Though waves may break, my ship shall take me off to the Land of Nod.
power: All Dreamers Draw top Psyche from Discard or Change Active Archetype.

name: The Visionary
flavor: Peer deep enough within yourself and you will find the seed of everything.
power: Flip and show the top unrevealed card of 1 Deck, 1 per Dreamer, or Reveal 1 Landscape per Dreamer.

name: The Runner
flavor: Nothing's faster than thought, and I *am* thought.
power: All Dreamers Move 1 space towards or away from Bed/Final Recurrence.

name: The Hunter
flavor: No Prey can escape my chase.
power: Move each Active Dreambeast a number of Spaces equal to Dreamers.

name: The Immovable
flavor: Even Time stands still for those who wait long enough.
power: All Dreamers Cancel a Discard or Forced Move.

name: The Weaver
flavor: Strands of fate, woven as I will it.
power: All Dreamers Trade up to 1 Card each with selves or Decks.
